shots.focal_element: Low-angle exterior of a glass skyscraper tower, symmetrical and centred, with a curved glass podium in front
shots.transition_other: video start; no incoming transition (anchors give none)
shots.what_happens: Cinematic establishing shot in letterboxed widescreen: worm's-eye view up a glass corporate tower against a pale sky, with a slight camera drift. Off-screen dialogue starts at w0 ('You're storing my...', w0-w2). Signage on a neighbouring building is environmental, not a graphic, so it is not listed as on-screen text. The last sheet frame (stamped 0:02.000) already shows the office wide of s002, so the sheet stamps may sit a little ahead of the anchor shot boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Open on 2 s of letterboxed (about 2.39:1 bars over 16:9) low-angle stock or drone footage of a glass HQ tower with a slow upward tilt, with no titles, and start the first dialogue line about 1.3 s in.

shots.focal_element: Woman in a maroon blazer walking down the central aisle of an open-plan office towards the camera; a seated colleague with a black bob and glasses sits at a desk on the left
shots.what_happens: Locked-off wide shot of a bright open-plan office with green desk partitions and monitors. The blazer-wearing woman walks forward in the right-centre of the frame while delivering her request about HR portal access (w3-w9). The seated woman is positioned as her target. Live-action comedy staging; no UI or graphics.
shots.build_rebuild: Film a static, symmetrical one-point-perspective wide of an office aisle with the speaking actor walking towards the lens on the right third and the second actor seated left, graded cool-neutral and letterboxed.

shots.focal_element: Seated woman with black bob and tortoiseshell glasses glancing sideways over a glossy desk divider
shots.what_happens: Reaction close-up with shallow depth of field: the seated woman gives a deadpan side-eye while the off-screen request continues ('compliance reports do and I', w10-w13). Blurred coworkers and windows sit behind her. Short (~1 s) reaction insert. The second sheet frame (0:05.000) shows the wide of s004, the same sheet-offset pattern as s001.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a ~1 s medium close-up of the deadpan listener, shot on a long lens at a wide aperture over a foreground desk edge so the background coworkers fall into soft bokeh, cut on the speaker's line.

shots.focal_element: Blazer-wearing woman, now closer to the camera on the right third, speaking insistently
shots.what_happens: Back to the same locked wide: the walking woman has advanced to mid-frame right and finishes the demand 'need that access ASAP.' (w14-w17), with the seated colleague visible behind on the left. Continuity of the walk compresses time between cuts.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the s002 static wide setup and cut back to it after the reaction insert, with the actor further down the aisle so the walk reads as continuous, holding about 1 s on the end of the line.

shots.focal_element: Seated woman with black bob and glasses, in profile, flatly replying
shots.what_happens: Same shallow-focus close-up angle as s003: the seated woman delivers a curt 'Nope' (w18) without looking up, which is the comedic beat of the cold open. A blurred foreground shoulder appears at the left edge in one sheet frame, suggesting the walker passing. The second sheet frame (0:07.000) shows the s006 wide.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to the s003 close-up angle for a 1 s deadpan one-word reply, with the actor in profile and eyes forward, and let a blurred foreground figure pass the left edge.

shots.focal_element: Blazer-wearing woman in the right foreground, stopped with a frustrated expression; seated colleague in the background left
shots.what_happens: Wide reverse of the office aisle: the walker has reached the foreground right and pauses, visibly deflated by the 'Nope'. The next line 'But my new agents are on it' begins at w19-w22 near the end of the shot. From the frames I could not tell which character speaks it: the foreground woman's mouth looks closed in the sampled frames. The last sheet frame (0:09.000) shows the close-up of s007.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the static wide for about 2 s with the frustrated actor framed large in the right foreground (background slightly soft) for a reaction pause, then start the reply line in the final half-second as a sound bridge into the next close-up.
